inferences.fact: Default30min lease renews for active real run. No tokenTTL override is passed by TaskCapabilityLauncher. token binding lookup precedes kernel ancestor, so an unchanged old credential rejected with real host requestId/AUTH_REQUIRED after stop is distinct from PEER_MISMATCH.

Task stop revokes managed run and signals the held PTY pid via node-pty SIGHUP. No static guarantee that reviewed detached worker survives: runtime before-positive/samebirth/after-negative gate mandatory.

Stock CLI requires two env values before ordinary stdin parsing, then verifies response requestId. task is a legal tab-list input, so nonsecret stdin task UUID holds a child only for birth capture. No response intercepted, no fixed numeric exit/op-id assumption on auth denial.
Known own process identity uses exact pid/start tuple; stopped/zombie distinct from unknown. Cleanup cannot mark unknown identity absent.
